text: Hello. My niece is 9 and is staying with me. Her temperature is 37.6, so not that high I think. I don't think she's had a wee since breakfast this morning, so well over 12 hours now, she says she doesn't need to go. Her breathing seems quite fast to me and I think she's working hard at it, I can see the skin pulling in under her ribs when she breathes in. She also has a pinkish rash on her chest but I did the glass test and it fades when pressed, so I'm assuming that part is ok. Possibly I'm overthinking it but thought I'd let you know.
